title: Discussing a New Routine

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

questions.prompt: How long does Eli plan to try the new routine?
questions.evidence: Eli: I am trying a different morning routine for the next two weeks. I used to miss breakfast when I had an early shift, and then I felt sleepy at the desk.
questions.explanation: Eli 计划接下来两周尝试新安排。

questions.prompt: What did Eli use to miss when he had an early shift?
questions.evidence: Eli: I am trying a different morning routine for the next two weeks. I used to miss breakfast when I had an early shift, and then I felt sleepy at the desk.
questions.explanation: Eli 以前早班时常错过早餐。

questions.prompt: What does Eli prepare the night before?
options: A bottle of water and a notebook.
A snack and a bottle of water.
A snack and a loaf of bread.
answers: A snack and a bottle of water.
questions.evidence: Eli: I prepare a snack and a bottle of water the night before. If I am hungry or thirsty later, I can decide what I need. My appetite is different on busy days.

questions.prompt: What does Nora usually do now instead of her old afternoon nap?
questions.evidence: Nora: That sounds practical. I used to take a nap every afternoon, but now I usually walk for a few minutes instead. I still rest when I need to.
questions.explanation: Nora 现在通常走几分钟，而不是每天下午小睡。

questions.prompt: What does Eli write in the journal?
options: The price of the wheat bread.
The time of the next cooking session.
questions.evidence: Eli: I have also written my bedtime in a journal. I do not think the notes are a medical test. They only help me remember what happened.
questions.explanation: Eli 在日记中记录就寝时间。

questions.prompt: What did the leaflet list as examples of nutrients?
questions.evidence: Nora: Our cooking group read a nutrition leaflet yesterday. It listed protein and fiber as examples of nutrients. It also mentioned a vitamin and a mineral, but it did not say that one food is perfect for everyone.
questions.explanation: 传单把蛋白质和膳食纤维列为营养素例子。

questions.prompt: What grain is in Eli’s bread?
questions.evidence: Eli: I brought bread made with wheat. It is one kind of grain. For supper, I will choose something simple after I see what is available.

questions.prompt: What does Eli sometimes do before the next meeting?
options: Stretch and take a slow breath.
answers: Stretch and take a slow breath.
questions.evidence: Eli: Sometimes. I stretch near my desk and take a slow breath before the next meeting. It helps me relax, although I cannot say that it removes every source of stress.
questions.explanation: 他有时在桌旁伸展并缓慢呼吸。

questions.prompt: What sort of change does Nora now prefer?
options: A gradual adjustment that fits her lifestyle.
A sudden change with no review.
A plan based on one day’s mood.
answers: A gradual adjustment that fits her lifestyle.
questions.evidence: Nora: My mood changes for many reasons too. I used to expect a fast change, but now I prefer a gradual adjustment that fits my lifestyle.
questions.explanation: Nora 现在更喜欢适合自己生活方式的渐进调整。

questions.prompt: When does Nora suggest comparing notes?
questions.evidence: Nora: Yes. We can choose a regular habit that fits our needs. We can compare notes next Friday.
questions.explanation: Nora 提议下周五对照记录。

instructions: This conversation is fictional. Listen to the conversation before reading the transcript and answer independently. After submitting, check the transcript and reasons for any errors.
transcript:
Eli: I am trying a different morning routine for the next two weeks. I used to miss breakfast when I had an early shift, and then I felt sleepy at the desk.
Nora: What have you changed?
Eli: I prepare a snack and a bottle of water the night before. If I am hungry or thirsty later, I can decide what I need. My appetite is different on busy days.
Nora: That sounds practical. I used to take a nap every afternoon, but now I usually walk for a few minutes instead. I still rest when I need to.
Eli: I have also written my bedtime in a journal. I do not think the notes are a medical test. They only help me remember what happened.
Nora: Our cooking group read a nutrition leaflet yesterday. It listed protein and fiber as examples of nutrients. It also mentioned a vitamin and a mineral, but it did not say that one food is perfect for everyone.
Eli: I brought bread made with wheat. It is one kind of grain. For supper, I will choose something simple after I see what is available.
Nora: Do you have time to be active at lunch?
Eli: Sometimes. I stretch near my desk and take a slow breath before the next meeting. It helps me relax, although I cannot say that it removes every source of stress.
Nora: My mood changes for many reasons too. I used to expect a fast change, but now I prefer a gradual adjustment that fits my lifestyle.
Eli: The instructor said to stop and ask for suitable advice if a muscle hurts. We can check our own needs instead of copying someone else's plan.
Nora: Yes. We can choose a regular habit that fits our needs. We can compare notes next Friday.
Eli: I will write down what I notice until then.
